title: the final frontier
tagline: The worst threat to life itself is making bad decisions.  The final frontier seeks to generate awareness of decision-making by building a model of conscious exchange.
description:
Did you know that every 2 minutes 3 people make the decision to end their lives.  The suicide rate is more than 800,000 people annually.

 What is your criteria for making decisions?

 The Anthropocene:

 We are in a new epic chapter of life on planet earth.  Survival on earth is at risk again, this time not because of a meteorite or solar flare, this time life itself is at risk because of man's unconscious consumption.  We are in a world where a few have the power to rule over the lives of others, sadly those who lead us do not have enough empathy to think about the other;  the inequality gap is getting bigger and bigger and the actions of those who control this game put us in more and more danger.  We are living a new era for humanity that goes against the very laws of nature.

 If the power to leave the game was in your hands, what decision would you make?  Be careful, because you could change the world.


 The Reboot:

 The digital age was marked with a concept that contradicts the nature of life, the restart taught us that if we make a mistake we can start again without any problem, society understood this as something unnatural, when really the restart wanted to teach us that the life gives us second chances and that if we want to do things differently we must learn from our mistakes.  We are at a crucial moment for life itself where new technologies represent an opportunity for change.

 the final frontier:

 We are a project that seeks to build fairer distribution models that allow a more equitable exchange of value.  But above all we are a project that seeks to call humanity to make conscious decisions.  These are the 3 main pillars of the project:
 
 1. Community gardens: People will be able to access a NFT that represents a KIT to sow, the type of seeds will depend on the location of the person.

 2. Green market: It will be the first marketplace that pays you to make purchases.  All sellers of green markets must have a circular traceability scheme and pay a small commission to be able to offer their products, this money will be distributed between consumers and the Planting Kits

 3. Circular traceability: Stores registered in green markets must develop a circular traceability scheme where they must share valuable information about the origin of their products and the entire production chain, but they must also involve the consumer about the final use that is made. give to the product.
how_its_made:
This project arises from the need to change the world.  the only way to generate change is if we work together and in a conscious way.

 This time I am not able to gather the team to develop a PMV but I can describe how it would work if it were developed.

 1. It is necessary to establish a medium that allows us to make transactions at a low cost such as Optimism or if it is the case, use a zkrollup such as Astek

 2. I would like to use web3Auth to generate an easy authentication in the DAPP
  but it would be necessary to generate a conscious consumption to use a world identification protocol as a world currency

 3. I would use IPFS and FILECOIN to store the data in a decentralized way and in turn would use THE GRAPH to index the data.

 4. There are other protocols you should safely use like Huma or Push Protocol

 My main challenge is to make this model a public good, for this I bet on the Ethereum prize and surely the problem I am trying to solve meets the agenda 17 of the United Nations, for this I bet on the Degate prize
